title: Conversion manifest
description: Contract for the shared conversion manifest: converted packages with digests for Godot-import readiness tracking. The neutral envelope is written by every converter; each package entry carries the policy of the converter that produced it.

policy.description: Neutral conversion envelope identifier shared by all converters.

result.description: Build outcome marker; only successful runs write outputs.

inputs.description: Input provenance: normalized content digests keyed per domain plus inspection and extraction fingerprints.

counts.description: Conversion totals: package count and summed per-entry output byte total.

packages.description: Converted package entries with digests, byte totals, and per-converter policies.

legacy_id.description: Converted package identity (sprite stem or legacy id).

bitmaps.description: Number of bitmap output entries recorded in the package.

output_bytes.description: Package.json bytes plus copied bitmap bytes; summed into counts.output_bytes.

policy.description: Policy of the converter that produced this entry.
